arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import statistics

# USDA outlays data (in millions) from 1990-1998
years = [1990, 1991, 1992, 1993, 1994, 1995, 1996, 1997, 1998]
outlays = [46011, 54119, 56436, 63143, 60812, 56667, 54338, 52558, 53949]

# Time variable: 1990 = 0, 1991 = 1, ..., 1998 = 8
x = [y - 1990 for y in years]
y = outlays

# Calculate means
xbar = statistics.mean(x)
ybar = statistics.mean(y)

# Calculate slope: sum((x-xbar)*(y-ybar)) / sum((x-xbar)^2)
numerator = sum((xi - xbar) * (yi - ybar) for xi, yi in zip(x, y))
denominator = sum((xi - xbar)**2 for xi in x)
slope = numerator / denominator

# Calculate intercept: ybar - slope * xbar
intercept = ybar - slope * xbar

# Predicted value for 1999 (x = 9)
x_1999 = 9
predicted_1999 = intercept + slope * x_1999

print(f'Years (x): {x}')
print(f'Outlays (y): {y}')
print(f'xbar: {xbar}')
print(f'ybar: {ybar}')
print(f'Slope: {slope}')
print(f'Intercept: {intercept}')
print(f'Predicted 1999 (x=9): {predicted_1999}')
print()
print(f'Slope rounded to 2 decimals: {round(slope, 2)}')
print(f'Intercept rounded to nearest whole: {round(intercept)}')
print(f'Predicted 1999 rounded to nearest whole: {round(predicted_1999)}')
print()
print(f'Answer in brackets: [{round(slope, 2)}, {round(intercept)}, {round(predicted_1999)}]')
"
